en_note: Machine translation by Claude (my reading), not on Pesna.org and not checked by a native speaker. Treat it as a study aid.
translator_notes: Traditional pastoral song, no author known. 'Двечки' I read as an affectionate form of 'two'; 'мори' is a filler, here part of the name refrain 'Maro oh Maro'.

lines.cyr: Абер дојде од овчаро, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: Aber dojde od ovčaro, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: News came from the shepherd, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: овците се објагниле, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: ovcite se objagnile, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: the sheep have lambed, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: двечки бели, две шарени, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: dvečki beli, dve šareni, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: two white, two speckled, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: Абер дојде од козаро, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: Aber dojde od kozaro, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: News came from the goatherd, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: козите се окозиле, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: kozite se okozile, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: the goats have kidded, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: едно бело, друго црно, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: edno belo, drugo crno, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: one white, the other black, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: Абер дојде од говедаро, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: Aber dojde od govedaro, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: News came from the cowherd, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: кравата се отелила, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: kravata se otelila, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: the cow has calved, Maro oh Maro,

lines.cyr: две теленца, близначета, Маро мори, Маро,
lines.lat: dve telenca, bliznačeta, Maro mori, Maro,
lines.en: two calves, twins, Maro oh Maro,
